description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set. The chart contains eight slices, each representing a different data source. The largest slice, labeled “NQ”, is blue and accounts for approximately 31.3% of the data. “SNLI” is represented by a light green slice at 15.4%, followed by “FEVER” in orange at 16.1%. “VITAMINC” is shown as a yellow slice representing 13.0% of the data, while “MULTINLI” is a red slice at 11.3%. Smaller slices include “ANLI” (teal, 4.6%), “FACTCC” (dark blue, 2.6%), “ENTFA” (light blue, 1.8%), “SCIFACT” (dark green, 0.1%), “SCITAIL” (pink, 1.2%), “PUBHEALTH” (brown, 0.5%), and “MULTIFC” (grey, 0.5%). The chart includes a legend listing each data source and its corresponding color, and percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
